description: Scan the coming days and return the first dates that have open start times. Use it when a visitor has no date in mind, or when the date they asked for is full.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.

participants.description: Number of people in the session.

start_date.description: Optional first day of the scan, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: find_next_available
title: Find next available dates
